description: This file provides utility functions and types for handling webhook request guards, body reading with size/time limits, rate limiting, and in-flight request tracking in a server environment.

methods.name: resolveWebhookBodyReadLimits
methods.description: Determines size and timeout limits for reading webhook request bodies based on profile and optional parameters.

methods.name: respondWebhookBodyReadError
methods.description: Handles error responses for webhook body read failures, setting appropriate HTTP status codes and messages.

methods.name: createWebhookInFlightLimiter
methods.description: Creates a limiter to track and restrict concurrent webhook handlers per key.

methods.name: isJsonContentType
methods.description: Checks if a given content-type string indicates JSON content, including structured suffixes.

methods.name: applyBasicWebhookRequestGuards
methods.description: Applies method, rate limit, and content-type guards before processing a webhook request.

methods.name: beginWebhookRequestPipelineOrReject
methods.description: Starts webhook request processing, managing in-flight limits and request validation.

methods.name: readWebhookBodyOrReject
methods.description: Reads a webhook request body with size/time limits, handling errors and translating them into HTTP responses.

methods.name: readJsonWebhookBodyOrReject
methods.description: Reads and parses a JSON webhook body, rejecting malformed or oversized payloads.
